data.name: Freemon
data.gender_notes: Freemon is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Old English words 'freo' meaning 'free' and 'man', signifying a 'free man' or 'freeman'. This name carries a sense of independence and self-governance, reflecting the spiritual values of individual freedom and autonomy in Christian belief. The name Freemon carries the meaning “Free man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Freemon usually hope their child will grow to embody free man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual journey towards self-mastery and personal liberty, embodying the Christian virtue of faith and trust in one's abilities to overcome challenges and live a life in accordance with one's beliefs.

data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, "Freemon" emphasizes the belief in God as the giver of freedom and the ultimate authority over one's life. According to 2 Corinthians 3:17, "The Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom." By carrying this name, an individual is reminded daily of their dependence on God for their freedom and their responsibility to use it wisely and virtuously in accordance with God's will.
